title: Stacked crate bookshelf
title_ar: رف كتب من صناديق خشبية مكدّسة
summary: Three sanded crates screwed together on their sides make a sturdy open bookshelf with cubby spaces.
summary_ar: ثلاثة صناديق مصنفرة مثبتة معًا بالبراغي على جوانبها تصنع رف كتب متينًا بتجاويف مفتوحة.
result: three sanded natural wooden crates stacked on their sides in a staggered tower and screwed together, filled with books and a small plant
steps_outline: Knock out loose nails and sand every surface, starting coarse and finishing fine
Arrange the crates on their sides and clamp neighbouring crates together
Drill pilot holes and screw the crates to each other
Stick felt pads underneath
Fix the top crate to the wall with a strap so it cannot tip
safety: Wear a dust mask while sanding and safety glasses while drilling
Always strap tall shelves to the wall, especially around children

title: Lined crate planter
summary: A crate lined with old fabric becomes a planter for flowers or herbs on a balcony.
summary_ar: صندوق خشبي مبطن بقماش قديم يصبح أصيصًا للزهور أو الأعشاب في الشرفة.
result: a sanded wooden crate lined with dark fabric showing at the top edge, filled with soil and green herbs and flowers
extra_materials: burlap or thick old fabric as a liner
steps_outline: Check the crate for loose nails and sand rough edges
Cut fabric large enough to line the inside with a 5 cm overlap at the top
Staple the liner inside, folding the corners neatly
Snip a few drainage slits in the fabric at the bottom
Fill with soil and plant
safety: Wear a dust mask while sanding
For edible plants use untreated wood only, never painted or chemically treated crates

title: Pallet coffee table
summary: A heat-treated pallet sanded, sealed and set on casters makes a solid low coffee table.
summary_ar: منصة خشبية معالجة بالحرارة ومصنفرة ومحمية بطبقة ورنيش ومثبتة على عجلات تصنع طاولة قهوة منخفضة ومتينة.
result: a low coffee table made from a sanded wooden pallet with a clear satin finish, standing on four black caster wheels
extra_materials: extra slats from a second pallet (optional)
steps_outline: Check the stamp: use only pallets marked HT (heat treated), never MB
Scrub the pallet, let it dry and sand it thoroughly
Fill gaps on top with extra slats cut to length with the handsaw
Seal with two thin coats of varnish, sanding lightly between coats
Drill pilot holes and screw a caster to each corner
safety: Wear work gloves and a dust mask while sanding, safety glasses when drilling
Never use pallets stamped MB: they were treated with a toxic fumigant

title: Pallet vertical garden
summary: A pallet stood upright with fabric pockets stapled behind the slats grows a wall of herbs or flowers.
summary_ar: منصة خشبية قائمة بجيوب من القماش مثبتة خلف الألواح تزرع حائطًا من الأعشاب أو الزهور.
result: a wooden pallet standing upright against a wall, rows of green herbs and trailing flowers growing between its slats
extra_materials: landscape fabric or thick old fabric
steps_outline: Use an HT-stamped pallet and sand the front and edges
Staple a double layer of fabric across the back, bottom and sides
Hammer down any loose nails
Lay the pallet flat, fill it with soil through the gaps and plant tightly
Water and keep it flat for two weeks so roots hold the soil, then stand it up
safety: Wear work gloves and a dust mask while sanding and handling rough wood
Secure the upright pallet to the wall so it cannot fall

title: Wood offcut coasters
summary: Slices cut from offcuts or a branch, sanded and sealed, make natural coasters.
summary_ar: شرائح مقطوعة من بقايا الخشب أو من غصن، مصنفرة ومحمية، تصنع قواعد أكواب طبيعية.
result: four round wooden slices with visible growth rings and a clear satin finish, stacked beside a cup of tea
steps_outline: Clamp the branch or offcut firmly to the table
Saw even 1.5 cm slices
Sand both faces smooth, working up to fine paper
Brush on two thin coats of varnish and let them cure
Stick felt pads underneath
safety: Wear work gloves and safety glasses while sawing, and always clamp the wood
Wear a dust mask while sanding and varnish in a ventilated room

title: Crate storage bench
summary: Two crates joined by a board and topped with a fabric cushion make an entryway bench with shoe storage.
summary_ar: صندوقان يربطهما لوح وتعلوهما وسادة قماشية يصنعان مقعدًا للمدخل مع مساحة لتخزين الأحذية.
result: two sanded wooden crates on their sides joined by a plank seat with a fabric-covered cushion, shoes stored in the crates below
extra_materials: a plank as long as both crates
steps_outline: Sand the crates and plank until smooth
Place the crates on their sides and screw the plank on top through pilot holes
Cut foam or blanket to the size of the plank
Wrap it in fabric and staple the fabric underneath a thin board or directly to the plank
Check every screw is flush before sitting on it
safety: Wear a dust mask when sanding and safety glasses when drilling

title: Pallet-wood wall shelf
summary: A section cut from a pallet, with a board fixed along the bottom, becomes a rustic shelf for plants or spices.
summary_ar: جزء مقطوع من منصة خشبية مع لوح مثبت في أسفله يصبح رفًا ريفيًا للنباتات أو البهارات.
result: a rustic wall shelf made from a short section of sanded pallet wood with a ledge along the bottom, holding small plant pots and jars
steps_outline: Mark and saw a section with two or three slats from an HT-stamped pallet
Sand all faces and edges
Screw a spare board along the bottom as a ledge, drilling pilot holes first
Fix hangers on the back
Mount it on the wall with plugs, checking it is level
safety: Clamp the pallet and wear work gloves and safety glasses when sawing
Wear a dust mask when sanding and check the wall for pipes and cables before drilling

title: Offcut phone stand
summary: An angled slot sawn into a block of wood holds a phone upright for calls, recipes and videos.
summary_ar: شق مائل منشور في قطعة خشب يُبقي الهاتف قائمًا للمكالمات والوصفات ومقاطع الفيديو.
result: a small sanded wooden block with an angled slot holding a smartphone upright on a desk
steps_outline: Mark a slot 1.5 cm deep at a slight angle, a little wider than your phone with its case
Clamp the block and saw both sides of the slot
Snap out the waste between the cuts with a flat screwdriver, then sand the slot smooth
Round all edges with sandpaper and add felt pads
safety: Clamp the block and wear work gloves and safety glasses while sawing
Wear a dust mask while sanding
